answer: Valid sponsorship requires summit: jetty serializes each operator’s lifetime head count, and head \(k\) needs \(2^{k-1}\) sponsors outside its ownership and funding graph; delta attributes keys and sponsor wallets to controllers, preventing resets. Each sponsor locks 100 summit until retirement, forfeited on sybil proof, and cannot back that operator again. Head one needs one outsider locking 100 summit. Ten heads need 1,023 outsiders locking 102,300 summit; head ten adds 512. Parallel recruitment or split funding cannot shrink this total; bribe costs grow exponentially.
